_comment: Jobs orchard, fish, iron, hunt, caravan, silver. Each interior (x 184..419, rows from y 319 at a 190.4 pitch, 158 tall, rounded corners) is fitted to the Collect window's 165:141 and drawn down to it: this painting is used as an object sheet, so its crops scale down, never up (SLICING_GUIDE, paint big, draw down). Sheet b repeats orchard, fish and iron; these are the ones kept -- object-led like the other twelve and unlike the deep mine's miners.
